faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SLK55 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. The R171 generation (2004-2011) uses the M113 5.5-litre naturally aspirated V8. The R172 generation (2011-2016) uses the M152 5.5-litre naturally aspirated V8 - a newer design that shares architecture with the M155 and M157. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SLK55 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SLK55 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M113 or the M152 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M113 SLK55 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M113 is a well-established AMG V8 of its era, and we service it to the same standard as our other AMG V8 rebuilds.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M152 SLK55 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals and coolant components as standard on every M152 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SLK55 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SLK55 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SLK55 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SLK55 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
